summary: fix(youtube): workspace use seeds the key ring only into a workspace with no credential of its own; returning to a workspace preserves its auth set-token key.
reason: Greptile P1 on PR #1755: re-seeding on every switch overwrote a workspace-specific credential with the globally active ring entry, silently consuming quota from a different key. Verified by hash-comparing the workspace credentials file across switch-away/switch-back.
validated_outcome: repro scenario passes: credential file hash identical across switches; go build + package tests green; fresh phase5 marker re-minted after the edit
